```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Paths relative to this file's location
project_dir <- ".."
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_functions.rda"))

paths       <- setup_project_paths(project_dir)
tables_dir  <- paths$tables_dir
figures_dir <- paths$figures_dir
output_dir  <- paths$output_dir
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)

select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r load-mitch-results}
# Load mitch TF enrichment results from script 05, Table E (direct
# targets: bound + regulated). Activated/repressed is encoded in the
# "set" column name as a suffix, extracted here.
df_e_all <- read_tsv(
  file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_tableE.txt"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      str_detect(set, "_direct_activated$") ~ "activated",
      str_detect(set, "_direct_repressed$") ~ "repressed",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TF = str_remove(set, "_direct_(activated|repressed)$")
  )

cat("Table E activated sets:", sum(df_e_all$direction == "activated"), "\n")
cat("Table E repressed sets:", sum(df_e_all$direction == "repressed"), "\n")
```

```{r select-top-tfs}
# Select top 10 TFs: top 5 by positive s.PC1, top 5 by positive s.PC2,
# union, deduplicated.
top_pc1 <- df_e_all %>%
  arrange(desc(s.PC1)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(TF)

top_pc2 <- df_e_all %>%
  arrange(desc(s.PC2)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(TF)

selected_tfs <- union(top_pc1, top_pc2)
cat("Selected TFs for GO enrichment:\n")
print(selected_tfs)
```

```{r load-table-e}
# Load Table E to extract target gene lists per TF (direct targets:
# TF both binds and regulates gene). Filtered to common genes used in
# script 05.
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)
table_a   <- read_excel(file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_e   <- read_excel(file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "Table-S3e")

common_genes <- intersect(pca_genes$gene_id, table_a$gene_id)
table_e <- table_e %>% filter(gene_id %in% common_genes)

# Target gene lists per TF (activated + repressed combined), selected TFs only
table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC), TF %in% selected_tfs)

tf_target_lists <- table_e_long %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()

cat("Target gene counts per TF:\n")
print(map_int(tf_target_lists, length))
```

```{r run-go-enrichment}
# Run enrichGO for each TF's target gene list. Background = common PCA genes.
universe <- common_genes

run_go_per_tf <- function(tf_name, gene_list, universe) {
  tryCatch({
    ego <- enrichGO(
      gene          = gene_list,
      universe      = universe,
      OrgDb         = org.Sc.sgd.db,
      keyType       = "ORF",
      ont           = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
    )
    df <- as.data.frame(ego)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      mutate(TF = tf_name)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error for TF", tf_name, ":", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL
  })
}

cat("Running GO enrichment for", length(tf_target_lists), "TFs...\n")

go_results <- imap(tf_target_lists, ~run_go_per_tf(.y, .x, universe)) %>%
  compact() %>%
  bind_rows()

cat("GO enrichment complete.\n")
cat("TFs with significant GO terms:",
    length(unique(go_results$TF)), "of", length(selected_tfs), "\n")
```

```{r plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Faceted dot plot: one facet per TF, top 5 GO terms (BP) ordered by
# adjusted p-value within each facet. Dot size = gene count, colour =
# significance. TF order reflects PC1/PC2 axis membership.
tf_order <- c(
  intersect(top_pc1, unique(go_results$TF)),
  setdiff(intersect(top_pc2, unique(go_results$TF)),
          top_pc1)
)

go_plot_df <- go_results %>%
  mutate(
    Description_short = truncate_label(Description, width = 45),
    TF = factor(TF, levels = tf_order),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(p.adjust)
  ) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  mutate(Description_short = fct_reorder(
    Description_short, neg_log10_padj)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(go_plot_df,
            aes(x = neg_log10_padj, y = Description_short,
                size = Count, color = neg_log10_padj)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~TF, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = project_colours[["grey"]], high = project_colours[["red"]]) +
  labs(
    title = "GO enrichment (BP) of direct TF target genes (Table E)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top 5 significant GO terms per TF | ",
      "TFs selected from mitch Table E enrichment (script 05) | ",
      "Background: ", length(universe), " PCA genes"
    ),
    x     = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    y     = NULL,
    size  = "Gene count",
    color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey40")
  )

print(p)
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(go_results,
          file.path(output_dir, "go_tf_targets_tableE.txt"))

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_go_tf_targets.png"),
       plot = p, width = 14, height = 10)

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
